rules.name: alkynyl_nitrile_thermal_polymerization_penalty
rules.chemical_statement: Conjugated alkynyl–nitrile/alkynyl-cyano and alkyne+strained-ring motifs are thermally labile toward polymerization/cross-linking and score ~18–24 points below additive H2-capacity predictions despite high H2 wt%.
rules.boundary_conditions: Lean carriers with conjugated diyne/nitrile or alkyne adjacent to aziridine/cyclopropane; penalty strongest at SA>3.5 and H2 wt%>6.

rules.name: hydroxyl_on_alkynyl_enone_ring_favorable
rules.chemical_statement: Adding a tertiary hydroxyl at the alpha-carbon bearing an alkynyl group on a maleimide/enone ring raises composite score by ~20 points with negligible SA change, indicating favorable polarity/hydrogen-bonding stabilization of the carrier.
rules.boundary_conditions: Observed for propargyl-substituted cyclic enone/maleimide scaffolds; benefit may invert if the OH enables dehydration under dehydrogenation temperatures.

rules.name: vinyl_appendage_on_alkynyl_enone_favorable
rules.chemical_statement: Appending a vinyl (C=C) group to an alkynyl-substituted enone/lactam ring increases score by ~19–20 points with only minor SA cost, consistent with favorable conjugation/unsaturation for reversible H2 storage.
rules.boundary_conditions: Benefit observed when vinyl is attached to a ring carbon already bearing an alkynyl substituent; may become unfavorable if it creates extended diyne conjugation prone to polymeriza

rules.name: alkynyl_nitrile_or_alkynyl_aziridine_thermal_penalty
rules.chemical_statement: Terminal/conjugated alkyne adjacent to a nitrile or strained aziridine/cyclopropane-fused ring is thermally labile toward polymerization and scores ~18–24 points below additive H2-capacity predictions despite high H2 wt%.
rules.boundary_conditions: Applies to lean carriers with conjugated diyne/nitrile or alkyne+strained-ring motifs; penalty observed at SA>3.5 and H2 wt%>6 where thermal cross-linking dominates real score.

rules.name: n_alkyl_carbazole_dealkylation_risk
rules.chemical_statement: N-alkyl carbazole carriers dehydrogenate stepwise before C–N alkyl cleavage on Pt(111); cleavage onset (~380–390 K) is largely chain-length-insensitive across ethyl/propyl/butyl, so the penalty is a fixed dealkylation liability rather than one scaling strongly with chain length.
rules.boundary_conditions: Pt(111) UHV; N-ethyl/propyl/butyl carbazole; dealkylation follows stepwise dehydrogenation at 380–390 K.

rules.name: ortho_methyl_shielding_of_ring_n_favorable
rules.chemical_statement: An ortho-methyl adjacent to a ring nitrogen sterically shields the N–C(alkyl) bond and modestly suppresses dealkylation, preserving reversible dehydrogenation; the favorable contribution is small and scaffold-dependent.
rules.boundary_conditions: Ring N bearing an alkyl/aryl substituent with an ortho-methyl on the adjacent ring carbon; effect modest and may be outweighed by other penalties.

rules.name: alkynyl_cyano_aziridine_crosslinking_penalty
rules.chemical_statement: Conjugated alkyne–nitrile motifs fused to or adjacent to strained aziridine/cyclopropane rings are thermally prone to polymerization/cross-linking, so real composite scores fall ~24 points below additive H2-capacity predictions; confirmed on terminal and internal alkyne variants.
rules.boundary_conditions: Strained three-membered ring bearing both alkyne and nitrile; penalty ~20–27 points, independent of terminal vs internal alkyne.

rules.name: aryl_aldehyde_ortho_carboxyl_deactivation_penalty
rules.chemical_statement: Aryl aldehydes bearing an ortho/adjacent carboxylic acid (or fused aryl aldehyde–acid) are deactivated toward reversible carbonyl hydrogenation by intramolecular H-bonding/cyclization, lowering real scores ~20–27 points versus additive predictions.
rules.boundary_conditions: Ortho/adjacent carboxyl on same fused aryl scaffold; penalty ~20–27 points; not applicable to meta/para or esterified acids.

rules.name: furan_alkynyl_ring_opening_penalty
rules.chemical_statement: Alkynyl-substituted furans/oxazoles are prone to C–O ring-opening and alkyne side-reactions under hydrogenation cycling, so real scores fall ~20–27 points below additive H2 predictions.
rules.boundary_conditions: Reducing/H2 atmospheres and metal catalysts that hydrogenolyze furan C–O bonds; not to non-alkynylated furans.

rules.name: aryl_aldehyde_ortho_carboxyl_or_fused_acid_penalty
rules.chemical_statement: An aryl aldehyde carrying an ortho/adjacent carboxylic acid (or fused aryl aldehyde–acid) is deactivated toward reversible carbonyl hydrogenation by intramolecular H-bonding/cyclization, so real scores fall ~20–25 points below additive predictions.
rules.boundary_conditions: Aryl/heteroaryl aldehydes with an ortho carboxylic acid or fused aryl-acid; applies under hydrogenation cycling where intramolecular H-bond/cyclization competes with carbonyl reduc

rules.name: alkynyl_amide_lactam_thermal_penalty
rules.chemical_statement: A terminal alkyne conjugated to an amide/lactam carbonyl (ynamide/alkynyl-lactam) is thermally prone to polymerization and side-reaction, so real scores fall ~23 points below additive H2-capacity predictions despite high H2 wt%.
rules.boundary_conditions: Terminal alkynes directly bonded to an amide/lactam carbonyl nitrogen; thermal cycling above ~350 K where alkyne polymerization/cross-linking competes.

rules.name: aryl_ether_aldehyde_ring_oxidation_penalty
rules.chemical_statement: Aryl ethers bearing a formyl group on an adjacent fused heteroaromatic (benzofuran/aryloxy-aldehyde) are prone to C–O/ring oxidation side-reactions during cycling, lowering real scores ~23 points versus additive predictions.
rules.boundary_conditions: Diaryl/aryl-alkyl ethers with an ortho or fused formyl-substituted aromatic ring; oxidative or high-temperature hydrogenation cycling.

rules.name: alkynyl_aziridine_nitrile_ring_strain_penalty
rules.chemical_statement: A terminal or internal alkyne conjugated to a nitrile on a strained three-membered aziridine ring is thermally prone to polymerization/cross-linking, so real scores fall ~24 points below additive H2-capacity predictions despite high H2 wt%.
